authority: existing PostTrainingLedger SQLite database; additive execution tables distinguish observed runtime evidence from compatibility caller-reported receipts
scope: bounded local deterministic environments and trusted side-effect-free local policy callbacks; held-out local model evaluation; no external model calls, network authority, privileged tools, or production promotion
policy_identity: canonical instruction/constant identity plus bounded defaults, closure configuration, referenced local functions/globals and captured local model digests; revalidated before and after each decision; captured state mutation fails closed
environment_identity: actual reward table and terminal actions bind the registered environment version and cannot be rebound by another execution
commit_boundary: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes cursor read, local policy decision, deterministic environment transition, RL receipt, runtime witness and cumulative usage; COMMIT failure rolls back
recovery: restore the environment directly from the last committed cursor; never call policy or step for a committed transition; uncommitted side-effect-free work can repeat
fencing: each runner admission advances a durable epoch; stale callbacks cannot commit after replacement admission
budgets: reserve each episode once; cumulative committed steps and started episodes survive restart; exhaustion and cancellation are explicit durable states
evidence: curriculum metrics derive only from execution-issued episode references; candidate qualification requires exact policy/model/curriculum identity and an execution-issued measured held-out evaluation
migration: additive tables in the existing SQLite ledger; existing record_step and record_curriculum APIs remain compatibility evidence and cannot manufacture executable qualification
rollback: preserve experiments and immutable RL/curriculum/evaluation history; withdraw execution without deleting committed evidence
